claims.statement: For the explicit product of 31 systematic [64,32] components and one [16,8] tail, and the counted marked-syndrome decoder of proof.md, the average block error for uniform 1000-bit data on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses is at most 999960630397147047/1000000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder uses exactly W=454 primitives on every received word and W<=2^(8827/1000).
